تلازمت (form VI)
# تَلَازَمْتُ (talāzamtu) /ta.laː.zam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# تَلَازَمْتَ (talāzamta) /ta.laː.zam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# تَلَازَمْتِ (talāzamti) /ta.laː.zam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# تَلَازَمَتْ (talāzamat) /ta.laː.za.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
